notes.title: Patch Notes v0.0.3.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831914/32b83c962567619b36a6970d2c064b4c4d2895cb.png

Thanks for playing Supermarket Simulator: Prologue.

We had lots of feedback and took action. Fixed 2 most annoying bugs.

Patch Notes

Fixed not being able to place or throw boxes sometimes
Fixed no customers coming the whole day
Moved the trash bin away from the delivery position so that you won't accidentally throw the filled boxes
Added tutorial step that shows how to use trash bin


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670630/Supermarket_Simulator/
Make sure you wishlist the full game that's coming soon.

Thanks for all the support. Have fun!
